summary: Vercel's Swiss-minimal page for the free Geist family (Sans, Mono, Pixel), drawn on a visible light-grey cell grid. A sticky Sans/Mono/Pixel switch re-sets every specimen on the page; the core components are a sticky glyph inspector with metric lines and a Solid/Anchors view, a one-line playground and a developer install section with copyable code.

'Geist.' in near-black at ~340px flush left on an off-white field ruled into a light-grey square grid; a small 'New · Geist Pixel now available' pill above; at the right edge tiny black tags '710', '530', '0', '-150' sit on the cap-height, x-height, baseline and descender guides
instances.ux: The sticky Sans/Mono/Pixel switch swaps the wordmark between the three families; 'Get It' jumps to the download section
instances.learn: Annotate the hero wordmark with its vertical metrics in font units: a single number column makes a plain name feel like a technical drawing
